rows.title: Rise from recent low (entry signal)
rows.description: Signal-only. Fires once, on the completed bar whose close first rises to at least X% above the lowest low of the last N completed bars (this bar included), after having been below that level on the previous bar. It rearms only after the advance falls back below X%. No exits, no positions, no P&L.

rows.title: Rise from recent low (trading backtest)
rows.description: Trading backtest. Buys (all-in, one position, $100,000 fixed notional) on each Rise-from-Recent-Low signal while flat, at the next eligible trade after the signal bar completes; signals while invested are recorded as ignored. Exits: the D1 profit-conditional trailing stop, plus (optional) the maximum losing hold and the buffered intraday-loss exit. Re-entry needs only a fresh signal: no lower-price test, loss restriction or reset.
